name: Rectangular Patio Table with Tempered Glass Top with Umbrella Hole and Steel Tube Frame
material: powder coated steel frame w/t tempered glass
description: Dine alfresco in the comfort of your own home with this large rectangular glass patio table. With a seating capacity for up to four family members, everyone is welcome. The thick tempered glass top consists of an umbrella hole for a market umbrella to help shade you while eating and socializing. The rippled top is smooth to the touch to keep your beverages and dinnerware level.
